subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Two numbers have an HCF of 18 and an LCM of 1512. If one of the numbers is 126, find the positive difference between these numbers.
questions.explain: For any two numbers A and B, $A \times B = HCF \times LCM$. Here, $126 \times B = 18 \times 1512 \Rightarrow 126 \times B = 27216 \Rightarrow B = \frac{27216}{126} = 216$. The two numbers are 126 and 216. Their positive difference is $216 - 126 = 90$.
